desc: Prove the trie characterization: a common prefix among k chosen strings corresponds to a trie node with subtree/pass count at least k.
Design trie construction with node counts, depths, and per-depth counts of nodes whose frequency is at least k.
Derive how removing one word affects only nodes on its root-to-leaf path, specifically nodes with count exactly k.
Implement an O(total character count log total character count + n) trie solution with temporary exact-k node updates and maximum valid-depth queries.
Verify the implementation using sample cases and targeted edge cases: n - 1 < k, k = 1, duplicate words, and multiple valid trie nodes at the same depth.
